items.name: Under-water-image-enhancement
items.description: Underwater images suffer from color distortion, haze, scattering, and uneven lighting. This paper proposes a MATLAB-based restoration method using constrained color compensation, dark channel prior, guided filtering, MSRCR, and adaptive histogram equalization. It improves color, contrast, brightness, and structural details.

items.description: This project focuses on image super-resolution using ESRGAN to convert low-resolution images into clearer, high-resolution images. PSNR and SSIM are used to evaluate image quality and similarity.
